findings.title: Silence action does nothing for Prometheus-only Grafana rules
findings.body: The new list items pass only promRule, and AlertRuleMenu now enables 'Silence notifications' using that rule's permissions. Clicking it only sets showSilenceDrawer, however: the drawer is still rendered only when rule is a Grafana ruler alerting rule, and requires that ruler rule as its input. Consequently, the silence option shown in both the grouped and filtered Grafana lists does nothing. Load the required rule on demand or adapt the drawer to the Prometheus-only path.

findings.title: Pause and delete disappear from the new Grafana rule list
findings.body: GrafanaRuleListItem now supplies promRule without rulerRule. Although this menu computes pause and delete permissions from promRule, rendering the pause item still requires a Grafana rulerRule, and rendering Delete at line 165 still requires rulerRule. Thus authorized users lose both pause/resume and delete actions from the new Grafana list. These actions need a Prometheus-only implementation or an on-demand ruler fetch rather than retaining guards that can never pass for list items.

findings.title: Preserve federated-group immutability in the CombinedRule abilities hook
findings.body: useAllAlertRuleAbilities previously checked isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group) and disabled update/delete for federated groups. It now delegates to useAllRulerRuleAbilities, which hardcodes isFederated to false and has no group data. Existing consumers of the CombinedRule hook therefore enable edit and delete for Mimir federated rules that were explicitly treated as immutable before this change. Preserve the group-level check when computing these abilities.

findings.title: Return disabled abilities when the Grafana rule hook is skipped
findings.body: skipToken is converted to undefined, but useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities(undefined) still marks Duplicate as supported and grants it to anyone with Grafana rule-create permission. AlertRuleMenu calls this hook with skipToken for every non-Grafana rule and ORs its result with the actual ruler abilities. As a result, Grafana create permission can expose Duplicate for external rules even when their ruler does not support duplication or the external create permission is absent. The skipped hook must return disabled abilities rather than abilities for an absent Grafana rule.

findings.title: Keep export available for Grafana recording rules
findings.body: ModifyExport support is now restricted to isAlertingRule in the Prometheus abilities implementation. Previously, the ruler implementation supported export for any Grafana-managed rule, including recording rules. Since the new Grafana list no longer supplies a rulerRule, recording rules now lose their Export menu even for users with export permission. Use the Grafana rule predicate rather than the alerting-only predicate for this ability.
